Action: Obtain and review current scoped independent assurance evidence; document exceptions and limitations.
Closure Evidence: Review record, scope validation and exception log
Closure Criteria: Evidence covers the contracted service and material exceptions have approved treatment.

Action: Confirm data categories, processing locations, retention, deletion and contractual privacy/security obligations.
Closure Evidence: Approved data-flow record and reviewed contract/DPA clauses
Closure Criteria: Data and processing scope are documented and required safeguards approved.

Action: Approve integration and identity design; constrain API scopes and privileged access; define monitoring and revocation.
Closure Evidence: Approved architecture, redacted access evidence and validation results
Closure Criteria: Only approved access is enabled; required authentication, monitoring and revocation controls are verified.

Action: Agree recovery objectives and obtain relevant recovery test evidence; track vendor recovery gaps.
Closure Evidence: Approved RTO/RPO, recovery test summary and open action plan
Closure Criteria: Business owner accepts evidenced recovery capability or explicitly approves treatment.

Action: Review subcontractors and contract flow-down terms; establish notification and reassessment triggers.
Closure Evidence: Subprocessor inventory and reviewed contract clauses
Closure Criteria: Material fourth parties and obligations are documented and reviewed.
